title: Silent outbox skip when get_mailbox_host returns None
description: kith-chat/src/message.rs:373 uses if-let to conditionally call enqueue: if get_mailbox_host returns Ok(None) or Err, the send is silently skipped. Message is written to the messages table with delivery_state=Pending but never enters the outbox. No error is returned to the owner; no log is emitted. Message sits pending indefinitely with no retry and no error.
